children: said on Tuesday it expected revenue from its railway systems segment to reach €3 billion ($3.4 billion) by its 2030/31 financial year.
Railway systems made up around 15% of Voestalpine's revenue in fiscal 2025/26.
The company also plans to expand operations in its aerospace, warehouse & rack solutions, and tubes & sections business areas, it added.
